events.title: 5,000 Wishlists, Next Fest and Roadmap
events.summary: Hey Everyone, An update from us as we move in Next Fest and closer to release.Next FestWe're so grateful to everyone who has supported us and played our demo so far. We've have a lot of really positive feedback and we're excited to be in this seasons Next Fest.We're entering Next Fest with over 5,000 Wishlists. Which has been so small feat. Thank you to everyone to has added us so far. To all the new people who will discover us during Next Fest - Thanks for giving 'More Than A Woman' a go!Roadma
